scope: 432 verified CSI hierarchy nodes including the Division root; four planned task frames per node, not 1728 ready assignments.
acceptance_definition: All mandatory criteria in a frozen scope/version pass on identified inputs and candidate bytes; independent review and integration are recorded. New requirements create a versioned extension, not a moved finish line.
stage_order_semantics: Consume only required accepted producer outputs. Parent frames aggregate own/child evidence; no need to implement a helper once per node or define the whole Division before one ready result.
rules: CSI classification establishes scope addresses only. Existing approved D01-D10, A01-A12, E01-E12 and imperial outputs remain authoritative in their existing scope. Criterion IDs below do not extend those mechanical rule IDs.

DEFINE.deliverable: Verified mechanical scope and independently expected cases, with admitted implementation packets and explicitly bounded missing inputs.

criteria.expected: The exact CSI number, title, parent, children, edition and catalogue page match the verified register; the mechanical source inventory has retained body identities and passages for the declared deliverable.
criteria.check: Compare the register row with the pinned catalogue and compare every adopted mechanical claim with its retained source passage; report absent primary bodies as failed input checks.

criteria.expected: The declared scope enumerates required types, variants, attributes, relationships, exclusions, services and children, with no unexplained omission; missing referenced inputs have explicit affected scope and resolution tasks.
criteria.check: Reconcile every applicable source clause and required child with the versioned taxonomy and coverage map, including obligations without material quantities.

criteria.expected: Each admitted quantity or obligation is bound to an applicable approved rule/version; conflicts, unsupported claims and missing decisions are separately recorded.
criteria.check: Check rule bindings against retained evidence and the existing approved D01-D10, A01-A12 and E01-E12 scopes; verify that source classification never supplies an estimating rule.

criteria.expected: Each admitted behavior has a nonempty independently established case set with exact expected results, units and any numerical tolerance frozen before implementation/evaluation.
criteria.check: Inspect expected-case provenance, hashes and version; require exact identities/counts/states, case-specific measurement tolerances and separately justified recognition metrics.

criteria.expected: The implementation packet names one deliverable, actual output dependencies, exact code/test write paths, current interfaces, check commands, independent reviewer and receipt location.
criteria.check: Resolve each dependency to producer output and scope and inspect named paths/interfaces in the current checkout; do not dispatch a frame containing unresolved implementation fields.

criteria.expected: The definition receipt separates ready outputs from blocked inputs and links a finite resolution task for each required gap; independent review and terminal outcome are recorded.
criteria.check: Check each gap for missing input, affected behavior, responsible action and finish line; verify that blocked cases are not advertised as ready or mechanically accepted.

RESULT.deliverable: Source-bound deterministic quantities or obligations for admitted scope, independently checked against fixed expectations.

criteria.expected: Every supported result preserves its exact source/revision/page/region or clause identity, taxonomy identity and rule version.
criteria.check: Compare the frozen source identity cases and reject missing or mismatched result-to-source bindings.

criteria.expected: Deterministic quantities and nonnumeric obligations match all independently expected admitted cases under their predeclared tolerances.
criteria.check: Run the frozen calculation/obligation cases independently and compare exact counts/states or numeric measurements with the recorded tolerance; no generated result may establish its own oracle.

criteria.expected: Inclusion, exclusion, lifecycle, package ownership and separate procurement/installation boundaries match their approved cases without double counting.
criteria.check: Run named positive, exclusion, duplicate, new/existing/demolition and package cases applicable to the declared scope.

criteria.expected: Missing evidence, conflicting sources and unresolved required inputs produce the expected explicit exception; UNKNOWN is never silently converted to zero.
criteria.check: Run supported-result and exception pairs; verify that UNKNOWN cannot satisfy a case requiring a known quantity or obligation.

criteria.expected: Only materially affected results become stale after changed relevant source/rule inputs, and deterministic recalculation preserves unaffected results and history.
criteria.check: Run the frozen changed-input and unchanged-input cases against retained prior result identities.

criteria.expected: Declared checks pass on the candidate bytes and an independent reviewer accepts the implemented scope; result outputs and integration are recorded.
criteria.check: Inspect command exits, actual-versus-expected evidence, candidate manifest and reviewer disposition; close only the scoped engineering task.

CONNECT.deliverable: The Mac review, reconciliation, correction, revision, reopen, Excel and evidence-PDF workflow passes its fixed cases.

criteria.expected: The Mac application consumes the declared source/result outputs and displays the correct section identity, scope and evidence.
criteria.check: Run the frozen application entry/open cases using the admitted source and result interfaces.

criteria.expected: Drawing, schedule, specification and responsibility discrepancies produce the exact expected reconciled result or review exception.
criteria.check: Run the named agreement, missing, conflicting, duplicate and assembly cases from the contract.

criteria.expected: A correction changes the intended result and affected calculations, preserving its source link and correction history.
criteria.check: Execute the correction case through the application and compare stored/result/evidence identities against the frozen expected transition.

criteria.expected: Save, close and reopen reproduce accepted results, exceptions and history without losing user corrections.
criteria.check: Execute the frozen persistence/reopen case in the Mac application and compare the before/after expected state.

criteria.expected: A revision invalidates only affected results and provides the required reconciliation/recalculation path.
criteria.check: Execute the frozen source-revision case and compare affected and unaffected identity sets.

criteria.expected: The Excel output contains the expected section/classification, rows, quantities/obligations, units and unknown/stale presentation.
criteria.check: Generate and reopen the workbook; compare its parsed values and source references with the fixed expected export projection.

criteria.expected: The evidence PDF exposes the required original-source references and agrees with the accepted result/revision.
criteria.check: Generate and open the PDF; inspect the frozen expected evidence locations, legibility and current-versus-stale presentation.

criteria.expected: All declared connected workflow checks pass on the candidate bytes and independent review/integration evidence is recorded.
criteria.check: Review the Mac workflow, workbook and PDF evidence together against C01-C07 and the named regression surface; record the terminal outcome.

QUALIFY.deliverable: All required scope and children satisfy SC01-SC08 on the frozen representative Mac dossier.

criteria.expected: Every required taxonomy item and descendant is covered by accepted SC01-SC08 evidence for the declared section version; no required gap is hidden by project non-applicability.
criteria.check: Join the complete scope/child map to accepted receipts and list any missing required coverage; parents reuse exact accepted child evidence rather than rerunning it.

criteria.expected: Representative original-source projects, independently expected outcomes, tolerances and review-burden thresholds were fixed before qualification.
criteria.check: Verify the representative dossier manifest, oracle provenance and freeze identity precede the evaluation and remain unchanged.

criteria.expected: The connected Mac workflow meets every mandatory representative criterion, including supported quantities/obligations, exceptions, corrections, reopening and outputs.
criteria.check: Run only the still-required representative checks; compare all actual outcomes with the frozen dossier and reuse unchanged accepted evidence by identity.

criteria.expected: Independent review closes all mandatory criterion failures in this scope, and the receipt records exact candidate/source/rule/fixture/platform identities and remaining unrelated limits.
criteria.check: Inspect the criterion-result map and review dispositions; expected UNKNOWN cases may pass, but required supported results or required scope cannot remain unresolved.

criteria.expected: The section/parent completion address, register receipt links and live next action are updated after accepted integration without reopening unchanged work.
criteria.check: Verify the accepted section version, all required child receipts and status handoff reference the same integrated candidate; later Windows/product gates stay separate.

definition_files.scope.json: Exact section/version, applicable source inventory, source-paragraph disposition and all required child identities.
definition_files.taxonomy.json: Required types, variants, attributes, relationships, exclusions and service obligations with verified source bindings.
definition_files.rule-bindings.json: Approved rule/version for each admitted quantity/obligation; conflicts and missing decisions explicit.
definition_files.expected-cases.json: Independently expected results, units, numeric tolerances, exception states and provenance; fixed before evaluation.
definition_files.implementation-packet.json: One bounded deliverable, exact code/test paths, writer, actual interfaces, output dependencies, commands, reviewer and evidence locations.
definition_files.input-gaps.json: Each missing input has affected scope, responsible next action, finite resolution condition and whether dependent behavior is unready.
